# tevsys
> Utility for MetaTrader 5 that enforces the loss/profit limits the trader configures (day and week), day OFF rules, and a lock that blocks new trade attempts when a limit is hit — intraday and swing. Documented close precision, HyperClose, and an audit trail you can cross-check with official MT5 reports. Not a signal EA. Does not trade for you. Does not guarantee broker fill price. Does not audit the broker as a service.

Canonical site: https://www.tevsys.io
English: https://www.tevsys.io/en/
Contact: https://www.tevsys.io/company/contact
Public claim: 90 documented operatives · mean close error ~0.06% under normal conditions (see /features/precision).

## What tevsys does
- Enforces user-configured daily/weekly loss and gain limits across the account from one chart.
- Closes exposure when a configured limit is reached (precision documented; decision vs broker fill attributed).
- HyperClose ≠ close-at-limit: HyperClose is only when protection is already on and a new trade attempt is made (also OFF-day attempts).
- Locks further trade attempts while protection is active (HyperClose closes unauthorized attempts immediately and records them).
- Swing / overnight: with an open trade under lock, limits stay those of the pact across day boundaries — we do not reset at midnight and orphan the trade. UI: "Trade in progress — you stay protected". FAQ: /como-funciona#overnight-faq
- Persistence: lock state survives MT5 restart and EA reinstall; if the terminal is off there is a real watch gap — on return, same pact % and limits-engine close if needed (not HyperClose). FAQ: /como-funciona#faq-espejo
- Optional SML (Smart Money Lock): tier-gated risk/reward layer under explicit rules — not "protect yesterday's balance" as a slogan; see product docs when enabled.
- Who it's for: traders (precision or under pressure), overnight/swing, MT5 funding challenges, layer under another EA, academies — not MAM/PAMM software.

## What tevsys is not
- Not trading signals or alpha generation.
- Not MT4 / cTrader (native MT5).
- Not a prop-firm risk desk or compliance/custody product.
- Not MAM/PAMM / investor-reporting infrastructure.
- Not forensic broker auditing; we produce a trader-side trail contrastable with MT5 HTML.

## ES (resumen canónico)
tevsys es una utilidad para MetaTrader 5 que hace cumplir las reglas que el trader configura: límites de pérdida y ganancia (día y semana), días OFF y el bloqueo que impide abrir nuevas operaciones cuando el límite ya se ha alcanzado — en intradía y en swing. Precisión documentada, HyperClose y acta contrastable con MT5. No opera por ti. No son señales. No garantiza el precio de fill del bróker. No es software de mesa de riesgo de una prop firm.
